name: MongoDB
look: Deep teal hero bands with bright green pill CTAs, stark white documentation surfaces and colour-tagged course tiles.

hero.title: The developer data platform built for change
hero.sub: A document database that does not make you write a migration every time the shape of your data moves. Search, vectors and analytics on the same records.

features.title: One database, several workloads
features.sub: Documents, full-text search, vector similarity and analytics — on the same data, without a pipeline between them.

items.title: Document model
items.body: Store the shape your application actually uses. Adding a field is not a schema migration and a maintenance window.

items.title: Search built in
items.body: Full-text search on the same records, so there is no index to keep in sync with a second system.

items.title: Vector search
items.body: Embeddings stored beside the documents they describe, queried in the same statement.

items.title: Analytics nodes
items.body: Run heavy aggregations on separate nodes without touching operational latency.

items.title: 100+ regions
items.body: Deploy across three clouds, with data pinned to a region for residency requirements.

items.title: Encrypted in use
items.body: Queryable encryption keeps sensitive fields encrypted even while being searched.

showcases.title: Schema changes that are not events
showcases.body: A document database lets the shape of a record evolve with the application. Adding an optional field is a code change rather than a coordinated migration, a maintenance window and a rollback plan.
points: Schema validation when you want it enforced
Versioned documents handled in application code

showcases.title: One system instead of two
showcases.body: Full-text and vector search run against the same documents as your operational queries. There is no extract step, no sync lag and no second cluster to keep alive at three in the morning.
points: No separate search cluster to operate

testimonial.quote: We removed a search cluster and a nightly sync job in the same sprint. The nightly job had woken someone up eleven times that year.
testimonial.name: Femi Adeyemi

pricing.title: PRICING
pricing.sub: A free tier that stays free, then priced on the cluster you run.

items.q: Is the free tier really free?
items.a: Yes, permanently, with 512MB of storage on a shared cluster. It is not a trial and it does not expire — plenty of small production apps live on it.

items.q: Do I lose transactions with a document model?
items.a: No. Multi-document ACID transactions are supported across collections and shards, with the same guarantees you would expect.
Yes, when you want it. Schema validation rules are opt-in per collection, so early development stays flexible and production stays strict.

items.q: Which clouds can I deploy to?
items.a: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, across more than a hundred regions, including multi-cloud clusters spanning providers.

cta.title: Start with the free tier
cta.sub: 512MB free forever, no card, no expiry.

footer.tagline: The developer data platform built for change.

notes: Deep teal hero bands with bright green pill CTAs are the opening signature; the documentation surfaces below are stark white.
Buttons are full pills and cards sit at 12px — the contrast between the two radii is deliberate.
Course and resource tiles carry colour category tags in purple, orange, green and teal.
One sans family carries every UI surface, with a mono face only inside code mockups.
The featured pricing tier takes a mint highlight rather than the deep brand green, keeping the CTA green distinct.
